title: Izwi Elimelene Nezisindo Zamanga
intro: Umphefumulo othembekile wakhuliswa phakathi kwabahwebi nabathengisi ezweni lapho izikali zazigobile futhi izilinganiso zazifinyezwa. Lo muntu wayemelene nokungathembeki kwesizwe sonke, esibizela ebulungiseni nasekukhulekeleni uNkulunkulu Oyedwa Weqiniso. Nakuba umyalezo wawucacile futhi ubizo lwalulungile, abantu benqaba ukulalela futhi babhekana nesiphetho esibi kakhulu. Ungamthola yini lo mthunywa ohloniphekile ovela eQuran?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesithunywa kubantu ababephila impilo egxile kwezohwebo kanye nokuhweba.
Abantu bakithi babaziwa kulo lonke izwe ngokunikeza isilinganiso esifushane kanye nokukhohlisa ezisindweni.
Babesabisa nabahambi endleleni futhi basakaza inkohlakalo emhlabeni wonke.
Ngabanxusa ukuba bakhulekele u-Allah kuphela futhi bathembeke ngokuphelele ekusebenzelaneni kwabo nabanye.
Benqaba umyalezo wami futhi basongela ngokungixosha mina kanye nalabo abakholwa nami ezweni.
U-Allah wangisindisa mina nabalandeli bami ngesihawu saKhe, kanti abenzi bobubi babanjwa yisijeziso esibhubhisayo.

outcome.label: Isiphetho Sabo
options: Amatshe obumba olubhakiwe awela phezu kwabo

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
